import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MODUL = 1000000007;

    static class Mat {
        long[][] mat;
        int size;

        Mat(int size) {
            this.size = size;
            this.mat = new long[size][size];
        }

        static Mat multiply(Mat a, Mat b) {
            Mat c = new Mat(a.size);
            for (int i = 0; i < a.size; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < a.size; j++) {
                    c.mat[i][j] = 0;
                    for (int k = 0; k < a.size; k++) {
                        c.mat[i][j] += a.mat[i][k] * b.mat[k][j];
                    }
                    c.mat[i][j] %= MODUL;
                }
            }
            return c;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        long m = sc.nextLong();

        Mat A = new Mat((int)(m + 1));
        Mat I = new Mat((int)(m + 1));

        for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++) {
            A.mat[i][i] = 1;
            A.mat[0][i] = 1;
            I.mat[i][i] = 1;
        }

        long y_factor = 1, y_power = 1, level = 0, sum = 0;

        while (y_power * m <= n) {
            y_power *= m;
            level++;
        }

        // Initialize bi_m as a 3D array: bi_m[level+1][m+1], each element is a Mat
        Mat[][] bi_m = new Mat[(int)(level + 1)][(int)(m + 1)];
        for (int t = 0; t <= level; t++) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++) {
                bi_m[t][i] = new Mat((int)(m + 1));
            }
        }

        for (int t = 0; t <= level; t++) {
            if (t > 0) {
                bi_m[t][0] = copyMat(bi_m[t - 1][0]);
                for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
                    bi_m[t][0] = Mat.multiply(bi_m[t][0], bi_m[t - 1][i]);
                }
            }
            for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
                bi_m[t][i] = copyMat(bi_m[t][i - 1]);
                // Swap rows
                for (int j = m - 2; j >= 0; j--) {
                    for (int k = 0; k <= m; k++) {
                        long temp = bi_m[t][i].mat[j][k];
                        bi_m[t][i].mat[j][k] = bi_m[t][i].mat[j + 1][k];
                        bi_m[t][i].mat[j + 1][k] = temp;
                    }
                }
                // Swap columns
                for (int j = m - 2; j >= 0; j--) {
                    for (int k = 0; k <= m; k++) {
                        long temp = bi_m[t][i].mat[k][j];
                        bi_m[t][i].mat[k][j] = bi_m[t][i].mat[k][j + 1];
                        bi_m[t][i].mat[k][j + 1] = temp;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        Mat res = copyMat(I);
        while (sum < n) {
            if (sum + y_power <= n) {
                sum += y_power;
                res = Mat.multiply(res, bi_m[(int)level][0]);
                y_factor = (y_factor + 1) % m;
            } else {
                y_power /= m;
                level--;
            }
        }

        long answ = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++) {
            answ = (answ + res.mat[i][(int)m]) % MODUL;
        }
        System.out.println(answ);
        sc.close();
    }

    static Mat copyMat(Mat original) {
        Mat copy = new Mat(original.size);
        for (int i = 0; i < original.size; i++) {
            System.arraycopy(original.mat[i], 0, copy.mat[i], 0, original.size);
        }
        return copy;
    }
}
